pipeline: StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True), fit on training only
full_feature_lr.convergence_policy: Stop the cell on any ConvergenceWarning; record failure; no test-based solver/search changes
full_feature_lr.seed_caveat: Deterministic solver may produce identical seeds; these are not independent data replicates

lightgbm.preprocessing: Same full feature array; no scaling; zeros remain ordinary values
lightgbm.runtime_gate: Before training, install pinned version in isolated environment and smoke-test API on synthetic data; freeze runtime manifest; record amendment if unavailable

selection: Minimum validation log_loss independently per minute and seed; exact tie uses first candidate
test_policy: Evaluate selected train-only fit once; no train+validation refit; no test/external tuning
